label: Whatever is LORD_2 is LORD_1
paraphrase: Open sense bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed. Whatever causes the being of every other being in act as to being and governs every such being (LORD_2) has dominion over everything else (LORD_1, the primitive Primitives.IsLord: authority to dispose of what is subject to it). After ST I q.13 a.7: things are subject to God as to their cause. It carries what LORD_2 leaves untyped: the passage from causal and directive power to authority. That step is the same in the old bridge, so it is not weakened here; only the antecedent is stronger. Strictly weaker than 'Whatever causes the being of everything else is LORD_1 of everything else' (its antecedent adds governance; Control part 2: a cause of the being of all that governs nothing satisfies this bridge vacuously and falsifies the old one).
